description: Extracts structured movie/TV show metadata (title, rating, genre, cast, directors, year, duration, description, trailer) from IMDB title pages using JSON-LD structured data.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_movie: Fetch and parse movie/TV show data from an IMDB URL; requires 'url' parameter; 参数: url, timeout_ms; 必填: url

url.description: IMDB title URL (e.g., https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0133093/ or https://m.imdb.com/title/tt0133093/). Required for get_movie function.

timeout_ms.description: Navigation timeout in milliseconds. Default is 60000 (60 seconds).
